purpose: Derive age group character variable from AGE with configurable cut points
call: %adsl_agegr(inds=adsl, agevar=AGE, grpvar=AGEGR1, grpnvar=AGEGR1N, cuts=65|80, labels=<65|65-80|>80);

purpose: Derive treatment character variable and numeric code from ARM using a mapping table
call: %adsl_trtvar(inds=adsl, srcvar=ARM, trtvar=TRT01P, trtnvar=TRT01PN, map=Placebo=0|Drug A 50mg=1|Drug A 100mg=2);

purpose: Derive actual treatment numeric code from TRT01A using a mapping table
call: %adsl_trtvar(inds=adsl, srcvar=TRT01A, trtvar=TRT01A, trtnvar=TRT01AN, map=Placebo=0|Drug A 50mg=1|Drug A 100mg=2);

purpose: Derive BMI group with built-in missing-value guard and configurable cut points
call: %adsl_bmigrp(inds=adsl, bmivar=BMIBL, grpvar=BMIBLGR1, cuts=25|30, labels=<25|25-<30|>=30);

purpose: Convert DTHDTC ISO 8601 character to numeric SAS date, handling partial and missing
call: %adsl_dtctodt(inds=adsl, dtcvar=DTHDTC, dtvar=DTHDT, fmt=DATE9.);

purpose: Convert RFICDTC ISO 8601 character to numeric SAS date, handling partial and missing
call: %adsl_dtctodt(inds=adsl, dtcvar=RFICDTC, dtvar=RFICDT, fmt=DATE9.);

purpose: Derive study completion Y/N flag from EOSSTT
call: %adsl_popflag(inds=adsl, flagvar=COMPFL, cond=EOSSTT="COMPLETED", label=Study Completion Flag);

purpose: Derive safety population Y/N flag from TRTSDT
call: %adsl_popflag(inds=adsl, flagvar=SAFFL, cond=not missing(TRTSDT), label=Safety Population Flag);

purpose: Derive ITT population Y/N flag from ARM
call: %adsl_popflag(inds=adsl, flagvar=ITTFL, cond=not missing(ARM) and ARM ne "Screen Failure", label=Intent-To-Treat Population Flag);

purpose: Derive enrolled population Y/N flag from RFICDTC
call: %adsl_popflag(inds=adsl, flagvar=ENRLFL, cond=not missing(RFICDTC), label=Enrolled Population Flag);

purpose: Derive randomised population Y/N flag from RANDDT
call: %adsl_popflag(inds=adsl, flagvar=RANDFL, cond=not missing(RANDDT), label=Randomised Population Flag);

purpose: Derive entered treatment epoch Y/N flag from TRTEPSDT
call: %adsl_popflag(inds=adsl, flagvar=EPOCHFL, cond=not missing(TRTEPSDT), label=Entered Treatment Epoch Flag);

purpose: Derive day of randomisation relative to screening using CDISC --DY convention
call: %adsl_studyday(inds=adsl, datevar=RANDDT, refvar=SCRPDT, dyvar=RANDDY, label=Day of Randomisation Relative to Screening);

purpose: Derive day of death relative to first dose using CDISC --DY convention
call: %adsl_studyday(inds=adsl, datevar=DTHDT, refvar=TRTSDT, dyvar=DTHDY, label=Day of Death Relative to First Dose);

purpose: Derive day of end of study relative to first dose using CDISC --DY convention
call: %adsl_studyday(inds=adsl, datevar=EOSDT, refvar=TRTSDT, dyvar=EOSDY, label=Day of End of Study Relative to First Dose);

purpose: Convert a raw CRF date/time into an ISO 8601 --DTC character value, preserving partial dates instead of dropping them
call: %sdtm_dtc(rawdt=raw_aestdt, rawtm=raw_aesttm, dtcvar=AESTDTC);

purpose: Assign the domain's --SEQ sequence number, unique within USUBJID
call: %sdtm_seq(byvar=USUBJID, seqvar=AESEQ);

purpose: Build one SUPP-- row (QNAM/QLABEL/QVAL/QORIG) from a single non-standard variable on the parent domain
call: %sdtm_suppqual(inds=ae, domain=AE, idvar=AESEQ, srcvar=AEACN2, qnam=AEACN2, qlabel=Other Action Taken, outds=_suppae);

purpose: Compute the Big-N denominator (distinct subjects) per treatment arm/column for headers and percentage denominators
call: %tlf_bign(indata=_tab, armvar=_ARM, outdata=_bign);

purpose: Standard company n (%) display format as an inline expression, suppressing the percentage when the denominator is zero
call: value = %tlf_pctfmt(n=n, bign=bigN, dec=1);
